subject.title: fix(cli): silent drop of malformed post-core install-records JSON

question: Should post-core update resume abort when a supplied install-record handoff is malformed or unreadable instead of continuing without the parent recovery snapshot?
rationale: The patch correctly prevents silent context loss, but it intentionally turns corrupt internal handoff state into an update-stopping error after core replacement, which requires maintainer acceptance of the availability tradeoff.

options.title: Keep fail-closed behavior
options.body: Merge the narrow reader change after confirming the existing update repair or rerun guidance adequately recovers operators from this error.

options.title: Continue with a warning
options.body: Preserve update availability by logging the handoff failure and continuing, while accepting that parent plugin recovery context may be lost.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed behavior
recommendation.body: Merge the narrow reader change after confirming the existing update repair or rerun guidance adequately recovers operators from this error.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is recent merged work on plugin configuration mutation and update safety adjacent to this handoff boundary.
